question_text: A LGU cooperative deposited ₱50,000 in a government savings account earning 6% simple annual interest. How much total interest will the account earn after 3 years?

hint_ladder.title: Ano ba talaga ang simple interest?
hint_ladder.text: Simple interest = parehas na tubo taon-taon, base lang sa original deposit. Walang compounding. So ang tanong ay: magkano tubo kada taon, at ilang ...

hint_ladder.title: Formula na dapat tandaan
hint_ladder.text: Interest = Principal × Rate × Time. Principal = unang halaga, Rate = percent as decimal (6% = 0.06), Time = years. I-plug in lang.

hint_ladder.title: Unahin ang pag-convert ng percent
hint_ladder.text: Bago multiply, gawing decimal ang percent: 6% = 0.06. Kung 6 ang ginamit, x100 ang sagot. Kaya always: × 0.06.

hint_ladder.title: Tapusin na ang calculation
hint_ladder.text: 50,000 × 0.06 = 3,000 (1 taon). × 3 taon = 9,000. Ito ang total interest, walang halong principal.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you stopped at one year's interest. Multiply yearly by 3.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you used 2 years instead of 3. Check the time given.

C.text: Correct. You computed 6% of 50k for each year and multiplied by 3 years.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you added back the principal. The question asks only for interest.

next_time_rule: For simple interest, always ask: 'Interes lang ba o pati principal?' If interest only, use I = P × r × t. 'Pag total, i-add ang P.
blueprint_id: Numerical Ability — Simple Interest Formula (I = P r t)
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mong nagdeposito ang barangay cooperative ng ₱50,000 sa Landbank, may 6% simple interest taon-taon. Ibig sabihin, parehas ang tubo kada taon.

Kunyin muna taunang interes: 6% × 50,000 = 0.06 × 50,000 = 3,000. Ito ang tubo sa isang taon. Para sa 3 taon, 3,000 × 3 = 9,000. Sagot: ₱9,000.
